Title: Bloodhunt called...no titled vampires, no PA cards

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
James Freeman <jfre...@darwin.bu.edu>

>Does this mean that if there is no titled vampires on the table and no
>PA in anyones hand diablerie may be committed freely? Barring the sixth
>tradition coming up of course...

The Edge may also be burned for one vote.

If nobody has any votes, yes indeed diablerie is safe. It is often
difficult, however, to *know* that nobody has as PA cards.

Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)

Messages.Author: James Freeman
Messages.Body:
Hello,

My play environment is a new one with all new players with about equal
experience. As the only one on-line in my group, I have been following
this newsgroup and the web sites. I am aware of the environment
questions like Golden Tennents, Card Limits, No Repeat Actions, etc. but
none of these problems have really come up in our games, yet. I am
playing some classic degenerate decks so that these questions do come
up. After seeing the consequences of not playing with a limited
environment we will make our decision on what limits we want.

This is a question that came up when I was playing my first effective
WVP deck vs a Gangrel Combat (pred) and Malk Block and Bleed Deck
(prey). The GC deck had recently torporized a vampire of my prey. I
moved to diablerize the vampire and was sucessful. There were no titled
vampires on the table, and noone had a PA but me. When the bloodhunt
was called noone but me had any ability to vote, I chose not to play any
PA cards because a tied vote is a failed vote.

Does this mean that if there is no titled vampires on the table and no
PA in anyones hand diablerie may be committed freely? Barring the sixth
tradition coming up of course...

Thanks for your time,

Jim

Messages.Author: Darth May
Messages.Body:
> Does this mean that if there is no titled vampires on the table and no
> PA in anyones hand diablerie may be committed freely? Barring the sixth
> tradition coming up of course...

if a tree falls in the forest...

think of it this way...you have noone with any influence over vampire
society to cary out a bloodhunt (no titled vamps) and you yourself don't
even have enough influence over the locals to get that sucker burned (no
political action cards). The one thing you didn';t consider was the edge.
If the player with the edge was particularly upset about the
eating-each-other-nastyness (s)he could sac the edge for that bloodhunt vote.

-dark
